unique_recommendation: Only one fixed 96-task acquisition-feasibility tranche may be considered for future authorization after engineering/partition closure; no automatic 384 extension, training or evaluation.

sampling.candidate_space_freshness: NOT_CERTIFIED; exclude all 2612 registered known-use tasks, all aliases/prefixes/seeds and background S; metadata difference is not clean certification
sampling.anchor_choice: Identity-only hash order within family and cycle through fixed d; never use future CONTINUE/teacher outcomes; no alternate prefix or task refill

partition_reservations_not_jobs.status: Metadata identity reservations only, require independent freshness and feasibility check before any future execution; scene disjointness not certified

collection_contract.cap_is_not_truncation: output_complete is authoritative under frozen producer EOS contract; complete=true/cap=true remains eligible
collection_contract.source_CONTINUE: Reuse one completed source suffix only with exact prefix/source/replay receipt; do not physically regenerate it
collection_contract.invalid_teacher: Record invalid/unexecuted, no learned target, recovery outcome NA_NOT_EXECUTED; no guessed failure/success and no repair
collection_contract.terminal_after_teacher: Valid terminal action permits zero suffix steps; success iff done and positive reward
collection_contract.first_stage2_after_invalid_stage1: Original single initial stage2 generation chronology retained, never execute action if stage1 invalid

common_pool.quality: One symmetric pinned-identity/source/replay/public-map/generation/execution/whole-branch-label/length-fit quality mask before outcome adoption
common_pool.B_pool: Q and teacher-branch success=1, with no exclusion by CONTINUE
common_pool.C: Q and teacher-branch success=1 and CONTINUE=0
common_pool.dedup: Physical event IDs, then already unique canonical task anchor, then exact public input+command; no slot refill; ambiguous multiple commands only disclosed
common_pool.label_identity: Within B, membership in C is exactly baseline failure; no novel value estimator or learned selector claim

proposed_one_shot_resource_guards_not_po.if_any_fail: NO_GO under this design, no 384 rescue-filling continuation; not a theorem of unlearnability

arms.B: clone P0 + S120 + sampled success-only B24
arms.C: same clone P0 + same S120 + sampled paired-rescue C24

learning_candidate_not_authorized.background_source: Already consumed original expert_train, not validation or new acquisition; fixed hash anchor and quality before new outcomes
learning_candidate_not_authorized.C_selection: First 4 by precommitted hash in each family; no effect ranking
learning_candidate_not_authorized.B_selection: Single precommitted hash sample within family and actual supervised-token-length composition of selected C, from all B including C; never filter on CONTINUE, never redraw
learning_candidate_not_authorized.contrast_stop: If selected B contains no neutral row or selected datasets are identical, NO_GO comparison; retain B as drawn, no replacement or resampling; any surviving claim conditional on the single declared draw
learning_candidate_not_authorized.same_target_supervised_tokens_per_update: REQUIRED_EXACT, including intended EOS; measured from labels != -100; padding and prompt excluded
learning_candidate_not_authorized.input_token_cost_parity_guard: Actual nonpadding prompt-token ratio max(B,C)/min(B,C) <= 1.05; measured/report, not falsely called exact equality; no redraw to pass
learning_candidate_not_authorized.truncation: Forbidden; fit audit applied commonly before label adoption
learning_candidate_not_authorized.checkpoint: Final update18 only; no validation-loss or online checkpoint selection
learning_candidate_not_authorized.same_initial_adapter_bytes: REQUIRED; current trainer fresh-base initialization is insufficient
learning_candidate_not_authorized.actual_tokenizer_audit: NOT_PERFORMED_BLOCKING; independent engineering task and separate authorization required
learning_candidate_not_authorized.S_only_arm: Not in minimal design; C>A alone does not isolate extra S updates, C>B controls shared S

budgets_if_future_feasibility_authorized.budget_stop: Before exceeding any limit stop and preserve incomplete units, no zero outcome imputation or task refill

future_efficacy_review_not_current_relea.statistical_test: two-sided exact McNemar with Holm sorted thresholds .025 then .05
future_efficacy_review_not_current_relea.CI: marginal Newcombe10 intervals, not a replacement for paired test or automatically multiplicity-adjusted
future_efficacy_review_not_current_relea.paired_units: canonical task, same initial trial/seed per actor, every technical missing remains unresolved, behavior fail-closed is failure
future_efficacy_review_not_current_relea.joint_acceptance_power: NOT_ESTABLISHED; hypothetical single-pair paper calculations only
future_efficacy_review_not_current_relea.release: Separate human authorization and independently reviewed frozen student/source code required

blocking_conditions: Independently reviewed new-study protocol including exception to old P0 recovery-target prohibition
Metadata partition realization and registered-use/alias checks; no fresh certificate from 1141/74 counts alone
Exact role/model/tokenizer/adapter pin and source-CONTINUE reuse evidence contracts
Warm-start P0 and final-checkpoint training path not provided by current trainer
Post-feasibility one-shot yield/coverage gates and complete budget audit
Separate research funding decision for any training and 600-task three-arm evaluation
claim_limits: Intervention rescue is not learning gain
Single observed paired rollout is not expected action advantage
Family/token-length matching does not equalize baseline failure or latent difficulty
Within B, matching full baseline-failure composition makes B and C the same class
No first-in-literature, learned selector, general self-improvement or cross-seed/scene generalization claim
Historical10/169 and R19 oracle not used as future-yield/effect priors
